results.title: Global perturbation potential function on complete special holonomy manifolds
results.theorem:
Let $(X,\omega)$ be a complete Riemannian manifold equipped with a non-zero parallel differential $k$-form $\omega$. Suppose that there exist a smooth exhaustion function $\lambda\geq 1$ on $X$ and a $k$-form $\omega^{\prime}$ on $X$ such that $\omega=(-1)^{\tilde{C}}dd_{C}f+\omega^{\prime}$. Also assume that the function $f$ satisfies the convexity condition on $X$, i.e., for some $A,B\geq 0$, $|df|^{2}\leq A+Bf$. Then for any $h\in\mathcal{H}^{p}_{(2)}(X)$, we have



$\|\omega\wedge h\|_{L^{2}(X)}\leq\|\omega^{\prime}\wedge h\|_{L^{2}(X)}.$

results.title: The weak solutions to complex Hessian equations
results.theorem:
Let $\chi\in\bar{\Gamma}^{m}_{\omega}$ be a closed real $(1,1)$-form, and $\tilde{\chi}$ be a semipositive and big closed $(1,1)$-form on compact Kähler manifolds $(M,\omega)$ without boundary in this section. Assume that under pluripotential sense



$(\chi+\tilde{\chi}+\sqrt{-1}\partial\bar{\partial}\varphi_{1})^{m}\wedge\omega^{n-m}=e^{mf}\omega^{n},\quad ess\sup_{M}\varphi_{1}=0$

(5.1)


and



$(\chi+\tilde{\chi}+\sqrt{-1}\partial\bar{\partial}\varphi_{2})^{m}\wedge\omega^{n-m}=e^{mf}\omega^{n},\quad ess\sup_{M}\varphi_{2}=0.$

(5.2)


Then $\varphi_{1}=\varphi_{2}$ almost everywhere.

results.title: The Dynamical Manin-Mumford Conjecture and the Dynamical Bogomolov Conjecture for endomorphisms of (P^1)^n
results.theorem:
Let $r_{1}$ and $r_{2}$ be positive real numbers and let $u_{1},\cdots,u_{n}$ and $u$ be continuous subharmonic functions on $D(0,r_{1})$, respectively on $D(0,r_{2})$. Let $\theta$ be a holomorphic map from $D_{n}(\tilde{0},r_{1})$ to $D(0,r_{2})$ and moreover, assume the following two $(n,n)$-currents satisfy the relation:



$dd^{c}u_{1}(x_{1})\wedge\cdots\wedge dd^{c}u_{n}(x_{n})=c_{0}\cdot dd^{c}u_{1}(x_{1})\wedge\cdots\wedge dd^{c}u_{n-1}(x_{n-1})\wedge dd^{c}u\circ\theta(\tilde{x})$



on $D_{n}(\tilde{0},r_{1})$ for some constant $c_{0}>0$. Then for any given point $\underline{\alpha}$ in the support of $dd^{c}u_{1}(x_{1})\wedge\cdots\wedge dd^{c}u_{n-1}(x_{n-1})$, we have the following equality of $(1,1)$-currents on $D(0,r_{1})$:



$dd^{c}u_{n}(x_{n})=c_{0}\cdot dd^{c}u\circ\theta(\underline{\alpha},x_{n}).$

results.title: Pluripotential estimates on compact Hermitian manifolds
results.theorem:
Let $\operatorname{{\it\omega}}$ be a Hermitian metric on a complex compact manifold $X$ of dimension 2 and let $u,\ v\in\operatorname{{\it PSH(X,\operatorname{{\it\omega}})}}\cap L^{\infty}(X)$. Let also $\phi$ be defined by the Gauduchon condition with respect to $\operatorname{{\it\omega}}$. Then the following comparison principle holds



$\operatorname{{\it\int_{\{u<v\}}}}2(\operatorname{{\it e^{\phi}}}-1)\operatorname{{\it\operatorname{{\it\omega}}_{v}}}\operatorname{\wedge}\operatorname{{\it\omega}}+\operatorname{{\it\int_{\{u<v\}}}}\operatorname{{\it\operatorname{{\it\omega}}_{v}}}^{2}\leq\operatorname{{\it\int_{\{u<v\}}}}2(\operatorname{{\it e^{\phi}}}-1)\operatorname{{\it\operatorname{{\it\omega}}_{u}}}\operatorname{\wedge}\operatorname{{\it\omega}}+\operatorname{{\it\int_{\{u<v\}}}}\operatorname{{\it\operatorname{{\it\omega}}_{u}}}^{2}.$

results.title: Weighted Green functions for complex Hessian operators
results.theorem:
Let $E\subset\Omega$ be a compact subset of Lebesgue measure $0$. Let $u,v\in\mathcal{SH}_{m}(\Omega)\cap L^{\infty}_{loc}(\Omega\setminus E)$ such that $\liminf_{z\rightarrow\zeta}(u(z)-v(z))\geq 0$. Assume that the following properties hold


$(i)$ $\int_{E}(dd^{c}u)^{m}\wedge\beta^{n-m}=c_{m,n}\sum_{a\in A_{u}}\nu_{m}(u,a)^{m}$,


$(ii)$ $(dd^{c}v)^{m}\wedge\beta^{n-m}\geq(dd^{c}u)^{m}\wedge\beta^{n-m}$, in the sense of measures on $\Omega\setminus E$,


$(iii)$ $\nu_{m}(v,a)\geq\nu_{m}(u,a)$ for any $a\in E$.


Then $u\geq v$ in $\Omega$.

results.title: Weak solutions to the complex Monge-Ampère equation on Hermitian manifolds
results.theorem:
Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Hermitian manifold and
suppose that $\varphi,\psi\in PSH(\omega)\cap L^{\infty}(X)$. Fix $0<\varepsilon<1$ and set
$m(\varepsilon)=\inf_{X}[\varphi-(1-\varepsilon)\psi]$.
Then, for any $0<s<\frac{\varepsilon^{3}}{16B}$, we have



$\int_{\{\varphi<(1-\varepsilon)\psi+m(\varepsilon)+s\}}\omega_{(1-\varepsilon)\psi}^{n}\leq(1+\frac{s}{\varepsilon^{n}}\,C)\int_{\{\varphi<(1-\varepsilon)\psi+m(\varepsilon)+s\}}\omega_{\varphi}^{n},$



where $C$ is a uniform constant depending only on $n,B$.

results.title: A Chern-Calabi flow on Hermitian manifolds
results.theorem: Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Hermitian manifold with $c_{1}^{\operatorname{BC}}(X)=0$ and $\omega$ satisfying $\partial\bar{\partial}\omega^{k}=0$ for $k=1,2$. If $\omega_{\varphi}=\omega+\sqrt{-1}\partial\bar{\partial}\varphi$ for a smooth potential function $\varphi$ on $X$, then for any $0<\alpha<1$, there exists $C$ depending only on $(X,\omega)$, $\|\operatorname{R}_{\varphi}\|_{C^{0}}$, and an upper bound for $\emph{Mab}_{\omega}(\omega_{\varphi})$ such that $\|\varphi\|_{C^{3,\alpha}(X,\omega)}\leq C.$

results.title: Quantitative stability for the complex Monge-Ampere equations
results.theorem:
Let $\theta$ be a closed smooth real $(1,1)$-form and $\phi$ be a negative $\theta$-psh function such that $\varrho:=\mathop{\mathrm{vol}}(\theta_{\phi})>0$. Let $\chi,\tilde{\chi}\in\widetilde{\mathcal{W}}^{-}\cup\mathcal{W}^{+}_{M}$ ($M\geq 1$) such that $\tilde{\chi}\leq\chi$. Let $B\geq 1$ be a constant and let $u_{j},\psi_{j}\in\mathcal{E}(X,\theta,\phi)$ satisfy $u_{1}\leq u_{2}$ and



$E^{0}_{\tilde{\chi},\theta,\phi}(u_{j})+E^{0}_{\tilde{\chi},\theta,\phi}(\psi_{j})\leq B,$



for $j=1,2$. Then there exists a constant $C_{n}>0$ depending only on $n$ and $M$ such that



$\displaystyle\int_{X}-\chi(u_{1}-u_{2})(\theta_{\psi_{1}}^{n}-\theta_{\psi_{2}}^{n})\leq C_{n}\varrho B^{2}(1-\tilde{\chi}(-1))^{2}Q^{\circ n}\big{(}I^{0}_{\chi}(u_{1},u_{2})\big{)},$

(3.3)


where $Q$ is defined by (3.1), and $Q^{\circ n}:=Q\circ Q\circ\cdots\circ Q$ ($n$-iterate of $Q$).

results.theorem:
Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Hermitian manifold of complex dimension $n$. Let $\beta$ be a smooth real $(1,1)$-form on $X$ such that there exists $\rho\in\mbox{PSH}(X,\beta)\cap L^{\infty}(X)$. Let $0\leq f\in L^{p}(X,\omega^{n})$, $p>1$, be such that $\int_{X}f\omega^{n}=\int_{X}\beta^{n}>0$. Then there exists a unique real-valued function $\varphi\in\mbox{PSH}(X,\beta)\cap L^{\infty}(X)$, satisfying



$(\beta+dd^{c}\varphi)^{n}=f\omega^{n}$



in the weak sense of currents, and $\|\varphi\|_{L^{\infty}(X)}\leq C(X,\omega,\beta,M,\|f\|_{p})$.
